    <script type="text/javascript">
        function setDropdownState(dropdown, isOpen) {
            if (!dropdown) return;

            var content = dropdown.querySelector(".dropdown-content");
            var btn = dropdown.querySelector(".theme-toggle");
            var menuLinks = dropdown.querySelectorAll(".dropdown-content a");

            if (isOpen) {
                if (content) {
                    content.style.display = "block";
                    content.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
                }
                if (btn) btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
                menuLinks.forEach(function (link) { link.setAttribute("tabindex", "0"); });
            } else {
                dropdown.classList.remove("open");
                dropdown.classList.remove("sfHover");
                if (content) {
                    content.style.display = "none";
                    content.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
                }
                if (btn) btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
                menuLinks.forEach(function (link) { link.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1"); });
            }
        }

        function closeAllDropdowns() {
            var dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll(".dropdown");
            dropdowns.forEach(function (d) { setDropdownState(d, false); });
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
            closeAllDropdowns();

            var toggles = document.querySelectorAll(".theme-toggle");

            toggles.forEach(function (toggle) {
                toggle.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();

                    var dropdown = toggle.closest(".dropdown");
                    var wasOpen = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";

                    closeAllDropdowns();
                    if (!wasOpen) {
                        setDropdownState(dropdown, true);
                    }
                });

                toggle.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                    if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " " || e.key === "Spacebar") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggle.click();
                    } else if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "Esc") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        closeAllDropdowns();
                        toggle.focus();
                    }
                });
            });

            var menuButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".dropdown-content a[role='button']");
            menuButtons.forEach(function (btn) {
                btn.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                    if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Spacebar") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        btn.click();
                    }
                });
            });

            document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                if (!e.target.closest(".dropdown")) {
                    closeAllDropdowns();
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "Esc") {
                    var openBtn = document.querySelector(".theme-toggle[aria-expanded='true']");
                    closeAllDropdowns();
                    if (openBtn) openBtn.focus();
                }
            });
        });

    <script>
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
            const carouselElement = document.querySelector("#myCarousel");
            const btn = document.querySelector("#carouselPausePlay");
            const iconUse = btn.querySelector("svg use");

            /* The glyph is a sprite reference, not a font element.
               Toggling icon-font classes stopped doing anything when
               the markup became SVG, and the old element lookup came
               back null, so the first setState() call threw and took
               the rest of this script with it. Swap the symbol the
               sprite points at instead. */
            function setPauseIcon(name) {
                if (!iconUse) { return; }
                iconUse.setAttribute("href", "#icon-" + name);
                iconUse.setAttributeNS(
                    "http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink",
                    "xlink:href", "#icon-" + name);
            }
            const srText = document.getElementById("carouselPausePlayText");
            const status = document.getElementById("carouselStatus");
            const controls = carouselElement.querySelectorAll(".carousel-control");

            let isPaused = false;
            let announceNextSlide = false;
            let statusTimer = null;

            function getActiveItem() {
                return carouselElement.querySelector(".carousel-inner .item.active");
            }

            function getActiveImage() {
                const activeItem = getActiveItem();
                return activeItem ? activeItem.querySelector("img") : null;
            }

            function getActiveSlideText() {
                const activeImage = getActiveImage();
                if (!activeImage) {
                    return "";
                }

                return activeImage.getAttribute("alt") || activeImage.getAttribute("title") || "Current banner";
            }

            function updateSlideAccessibility(announce) {
                const items = carouselElement.querySelectorAll(".carousel-inner .item");
                items.forEach(function (item) {
                    const image = item.querySelector("img");
                    const isActive = item.classList.contains("active");
                    item.setAttribute("aria-hidden", isActive ? "false" : "true");
                    if (image) {
                        image.setAttribute("tabindex", isActive ? "0" : "-1");
                    }
                });

                if (announce && status) {
                    const message = "Slide changed. Current banner: " + getActiveSlideText();
                    if (statusTimer) {
                        window.clearTimeout(statusTimer);
                    }
                    status.textContent = "";
                    statusTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
                        status.textContent = message;
                    }, 100);
                }
            }

            function triggerControl(event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                announceNextSlide = true;
                event.currentTarget.click();
            }

            function setState(paused) {
                isPaused = paused;

                if (paused) {
                    $(carouselElement).carousel("pause");
                    setPauseIcon("play");

                    btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Play banner rotation");
                    btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
                    btn.title = "Play banner";
                    srText.textContent = "Play banner";
                } else {
                    $(carouselElement).carousel("cycle");
                    setPauseIcon("pause");

                    btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Pause banner rotation");
                    btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
                    btn.title = "Pause banner";
                    srText.textContent = "Pause banner";
                }
            }

            setState(false);
            updateSlideAccessibility(false);

            btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
                setState(!isPaused);
            });

            btn.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                if (event.key === " " || event.key === "Spacebar") {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    btn.click();
                }
            });

            controls.forEach(function (control) {
                control.addEventListener("click", function () {
                    announceNextSlide = true;
                });

                control.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                    if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " " || event.key === "Spacebar") {
                        triggerControl(event);
                    }
                });
            });

            $(carouselElement).on("slide.bs.carousel", function () {
                if (status) {
                    status.textContent = "";
                }
            });

            $(carouselElement).on("slid.bs.carousel", function () {
                updateSlideAccessibility(announceNextSlide);
                announceNextSlide = false;
            });

            const socialToggle = document.getElementById("social-toggle");
            const fixedSocial = document.getElementById("fixed-social");
            if (socialToggle && fixedSocial) {
                function syncSocialToggleState() {
                    const isExpanded = fixedSocial.classList.contains("show-icons");
                    socialToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", isExpanded.toString());
                }

                /* The rail is pinned to the left edge at every width; what has to
                   change with width is whether it is OPEN, because the gutter
                   beside the Bootstrap 3 container is not always wide enough for
                   the expanded 44px rail. 1258px = the 1170px container plus a
                   rail each side, the first width that clears content at every
                   container step. Under 768px the rail is back in the flow and
                   cannot overlap, so it stays open there too.
                   These two numbers mirror the media queries in the stylesheet
                   below - change them together. */
                var RAIL_CLEARS_CONTENT = 1258;
                var RAIL_IN_FLOW = 767;
                var userHasToggledRail = false;

                function railShouldBeOpen() {
                    var w = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth;
                    return w <= RAIL_IN_FLOW || w >= RAIL_CLEARS_CONTENT;
                }

                /* add/remove rather than the two-argument classList.toggle,
                   which IE11 does not implement */
                function applyDefaultRailState() {
                    if (userHasToggledRail) { return; }
                    if (railShouldBeOpen()) {
                        fixedSocial.classList.add("show-icons");
                    } else {
                        fixedSocial.classList.remove("show-icons");
                    }
                    syncSocialToggleState();
                }

                socialToggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
                    userHasToggledRail = true;   /* stop resize overriding a choice */
                    fixedSocial.classList.toggle("show-icons");
                    syncSocialToggleState();
                });

                var railResizeTimer = null;
                window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
                    if (railResizeTimer) { window.clearTimeout(railResizeTimer); }
                    railResizeTimer = window.setTimeout(applyDefaultRailState, 150);
                });

                socialToggle.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                    if (event.key === " " || event.key === "Spacebar") {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        socialToggle.click();
                    }
                });

                applyDefaultRailState();
            }
        });
    </script>

                    /* ---- Social Engagements: equal column heights --------

                                    ratio

                                    its data-height="340" - but that SDK only

                                    to the one-line <blockquote> fallback

                       Flexing the row makes the columns stretch to the tallest
                       whatever each contains, which fixes all three causes at
                       once, including the consent one.

                       Only from 768px up. At col-xs-12 the three stack full
                       width and equalising them would just add dead space. */
                    @media (min-width: 768px) {
                        .social-engagements-row {
                            display: flex;
                            flex-wrap: wrap;
                        }

                            /* Bootstrap's row clearfix is `display: table`, and
                               as a flex item that becomes a phantom column that
                               breaks the wrap. The floats it existed to clear
                               are irrelevant once the row is flex. */
                            .social-engagements-row:before,
                            .social-engagements-row:after {
                                display: none;
                            }

                            .social-engagements-row > [class*="col-"] {
                                display: flex;
                                flex-direction: column;

                                /* The cards fill their column, so the white

        // ================================================================
        // ACCESSIBILITY: Contrast Ratio Calculator
        // ================================================================
        function getContrastRatio(hexColor1, hexColor2) {
            function getLuminance(hex) {
                const rgb = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
                const r = (rgb >> 16) & 0xff;
                const g = (rgb >> 8) & 0xff;
                const b = (rgb >> 0) & 0xff;

                const rs = r / 255;
                const gs = g / 255;
                const bs = b / 255;

                const rL = rs <= 0.03928 ? rs / 12.92 : Math.pow((rs + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
                const gL = gs <= 0.03928 ? gs / 12.92 : Math.pow((gs + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
                const bL = bs <= 0.03928 ? bs / 12.92 : Math.pow((bs + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);

                return 0.2126 * rL + 0.7152 * gL + 0.0722 * bL;
            }

            const lum1 = getLuminance(hexColor1);
            const lum2 = getLuminance(hexColor2);

            const lighter = Math.max(lum1, lum2);
            const darker = Math.min(lum1, lum2);

            return (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05);
        }

        // Determine if we should use black or white text based on background color
        function getTextColorForBackground(bgColor) {
            const whiteContrast = getContrastRatio(bgColor, '#ffffff');
            const blackContrast = getContrastRatio(bgColor, '#000000');

            // WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text
            const requiredRatio = 4.5;

            if (whiteContrast >= requiredRatio) {
                return '#ffffff';
            } else if (blackContrast >= requiredRatio) {
                return '#000000';
            } else {
                // If neither works, prefer white (more common fallback)
                return whiteContrast >= blackContrast ? '#ffffff' : '#000000';
            }
        }

        function initSectorCarousel() {
            try {
                // ----------------------------------------------------------------
                // 1. FIND ELEMENTS SAFELY (Using "Ends With" selector for ASP.NET IDs)
                // ----------------------------------------------------------------

                // Find HiddenField (matches id ending in 'SectorCarouselData')
                var hiddenField = document.querySelector('[id$="SectorCarouselData"]');
                // Find Container (matches id ending in 'EngPrCarousel')
                var container = document.querySelector('[id$="EngPrCarousel"]');

                if (!hiddenField) {
                    console.error("Critical: HiddenField 'SectorCarouselData' not found in DOM.");
                    return;
                }
                if (!container) {
                    console.error("Critical: Container 'EngPrCarousel' not found in DOM.");
                    return;
                }

                // ----------------------------------------------------------------
                // 2. PARSE DATA
                // ----------------------------------------------------------------
                var jsonString = hiddenField.value;

                // Check if data is empty or default JSON object
                if (!jsonString || jsonString === "{}" || jsonString === "") {
                    console.warn("HiddenField is empty or contains no data.");
                    return;
                }

                const data = JSON.parse(jsonString);

                // ----------------------------------------------------------------
                // 3. GENERATE HTML
                // ----------------------------------------------------------------
                const pressNotePage = { 16: "FactsheetDetails", 3: "PressNoteDetails", 4: "FaqDetails", 2: "FeaturesDeatils", 1: "PressNoteDetails" };
                const colorCodes = { 2: "#5B9BD5", 3: "#4472C4", 4: "#17B050", 5: "#92D050", 6: "#ED7D32", 7: "#7030A0", 8: "#33CCCC", 9: "#FFC000", 10: "#00B0F0", 11: "#FF7473", 12: "#008080", 13: "#2f2f2f" };

                let fullHtml = '';
                let slideCount = 0;

                for (const sectorId in data) {
                    const items = data[sectorId];
                    if (!items || items.length === 0) continue;

                    slideCount++;
                    let parentId = items[0].ParentSectorId;
                    let sectorName = items[0].SectorName;
                    let bgStyle = colorCodes[parentId] ? colorCodes[parentId] : "#2f2f2f";
                    let textColor = getTextColorForBackground(bgStyle);

                    let htm = `
                <div class="swiper-card swiper-slide" role="group">
                        <div class="swiper-card-image">
                            <h3 style='background-color:${bgStyle}; color:${textColor}' class="description">${sectorName}</h3>
                        </div>
                        <ul class='card__recentNotes'>`;

                    items.forEach(item => {
                        let title = item.Title.length > 70
                            ? item.Title.substring(0, item.Title.lastIndexOf(" ", 70)).trim() + "..."
                            : item.Title;

                        let pageName = pressNotePage[item.Module] || "PressNoteDetails";

                        htm += `<li><svg class="dbim-icon" width="24" height="24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><use href="#icon-circle" xlink:href="#icon-circle"></use></svg> <a href="https://pib.gov.in/${pageName}.aspx?id=${item.ID}&NoteId=${item.ID}&ModuleId=${item.Module}">${title}</a></li>`;
                    });

                    htm += `</ul></div>`;
                    fullHtml += htm;
                }

                // ----------------------------------------------------------------
                // 4. INJECT HTML
                // ----------------------------------------------------------------
                container.innerHTML = fullHtml;

                // Ensure the container has the class required by Swiper
                container.classList.add('swiper-wrapper');

                console.log("Slides Generated: " + slideCount);

                // ----------------------------------------------------------------
                // 5. INITIALIZE SWIPER
                // ----------------------------------------------------------------

                // We init on '.slide-content' because it is the direct parent of our wrapper
                var swiperRoot = document.querySelector('.slide-content');

                // Check if Swiper already exists and destroy it to prevent duplicates
                if (swiperRoot.swiper) {
                    swiperRoot.swiper.destroy(true, true);
                }

                // Find buttons manually to ensure they work even if outside the container
                var nextBtn = document.querySelector('.swiper-button-next');
                var prevBtn = document.querySelector('.swiper-button-prev');
                var pagEl = document.querySelector('.swiper-pagination');

                // ACCESSIBILITY FIX: Function to restrict keyboard tab focus ONLY to visible slides
                function toggleSwiperFocus(swiperInstance) {
                    if (!swiperInstance || !swiperInstance.slides) return;

                    Array.from(swiperInstance.slides).forEach(function (slide) {
                        // watchSlidesProgress applies 'swiper-slide-visible' to visible slides
                        var isVisible = slide.classList.contains('swiper-slide-visible');
                        var focusables = slide.querySelectorAll('a, [tabindex]');

                        if (isVisible) {
                            slide.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
                            focusables.forEach(function (el) {
                                if (el.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'h3') {
                                    el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                                } else {
                                    el.removeAttribute('tabindex'); // Restore default focusable state
                                }
                            });
                        } else {
                            slide.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                            focusables.forEach(function (el) {
                                el.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); // Remove from tab order entirely
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }

                const swiper = new Swiper(swiperRoot, {
                    slidesPerView: 3,
                    spaceBetween: 25,
                    direction: 'horizontal',
                    // Important: Only loop if we have more slides than view
                    loop: false,
                    centerSlide: true,
                    grabCursor: true,
                    observer: true,       // Detects changes to DOM
                    observeParents: true, // Detects changes to parent DOM
                    watchSlidesProgress: true, // ACCESSIBILITY FIX: Track which slides are currently visible
                    a11y: true,                // ACCESSIBILITY FIX: Ensure button accessibility is built-in
                    //pagination: {
                    //    el: pagEl,
                    //    clickable: true,
                    //    dynamicBullets: true,
                    //},
                    navigation: {
                        nextEl: nextBtn,
                        prevEl: prevBtn,
                    },
                    breakpoints: {
                        0: { slidesPerView: 1 },
                        520: { slidesPerView: 2 },
                        950: { slidesPerView: 3 },
                    },
                    on: { // ACCESSIBILITY FIX: Update `tabindex` constraints when swiper changes
                        init: function () { toggleSwiperFocus(this); },
                        slideChangeTransitionEnd: function () { toggleSwiperFocus(this); },
                        resize: function () { toggleSwiperFocus(this); }
                    }
                });

            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Carousel JS Error:", e);
            }
        }

        $(document).ready(function () {
            initSectorCarousel();
        });

        if (typeof Sys !== 'undefined' && Sys.WebForms) {
            Sys.WebForms.PageRequestManager.getInstance().add_endRequest(function () {
                initSectorCarousel();
            });
        }
    </script>

        function getCarouselItems() {
            return document.querySelectorAll('.nbs-flexisel-item');
        }

        function getPrevBtn() {
            return document.querySelector('.nbs-flexisel-nav-left');

        function getNextBtn() {
            return document.querySelector('.nbs-flexisel-nav-right');

        function refreshNavA11y() {
            var prevBtn = getPrevBtn();
            var nextBtn = getNextBtn();

            if (prevBtn) {
                prevBtn.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                prevBtn.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                prevBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Previous Slide');
            }

            if (nextBtn) {
                nextBtn.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                nextBtn.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                nextBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Next Slide');

            pibNavIcon(prevBtn, 'icon-chevron-left');

        /* jquery.flexisel.js creates these two controls as EMPTY divs and the
           stylesheet draws the arrow with a ::before character. This puts a
           real SVG in instead - DBIM 3.7(ii).

           Guarded twice: once on the sprite actually being present, and once
           on the class, because refreshNavA11y() is re-run on a timer and
           would otherwise stack an arrow on every pass. */
        function pibNavIcon(btn, id) {
            if (!btn || btn.className.indexOf('pib-nav-svg') > -1) { return; }
            if (!document.getElementById('dbim-icon-sprite')) { return; }

            var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
            var svg = document.createElementNS(NS, 'svg');
            svg.setAttribute('class', 'dbim-icon');
            svg.setAttribute('width', '24');
            svg.setAttribute('height', '24');
            svg.setAttribute('fill', 'currentColor');
            svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            svg.setAttribute('focusable', 'false');

            var use = document.createElementNS(NS, 'use');
            use.setAttribute('href', '#' + id);
            use.setAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink', 'xlink:href', '#' + id);

            svg.appendChild(use);
            btn.appendChild(svg);
            btn.className += ' pib-nav-svg';
        }

        function scheduleFocusRefresh() {
            clearTimeout(pibCarouselTimer);
            pibCarouselTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                manageCarouselFocus();
                refreshNavA11y();
            }, 500);
        }

        function isElementVisibleHorizontally(rect, viewportRect) {
            return rect.left < viewportRect.right && rect.right > viewportRect.left;
        }

        function manageCarouselFocus() {
            var viewport = getCarouselViewport();
            if (!viewport) return;

            var viewportRect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
            var items = getCarouselItems();

            // small tolerance for border/subpixel rounding
            var tolerance = 4;

            for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                var item = items[i];
                var links = item.querySelectorAll('a');

                for (var j = 0; j < links.length; j++) {
                    var link = links[j];

                    // skip hidden/renderless elements
                    if (!link.offsetParent) {
                        link.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
                        link.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                        continue;
                    }

                    var rect = link.getBoundingClientRect();

                    // Require FULL visibility inside the carousel viewport
                    var fullyVisible =
                        rect.left >= (viewportRect.left + tolerance) &&
                        rect.right <= (viewportRect.right - tolerance) &&
                        rect.width > 0 &&
                        rect.height > 0;

                    if (fullyVisible) {
                        if (link.hasAttribute('data-old-tabindex')) {
                            var oldTabindex = link.getAttribute('data-old-tabindex');
                            if (oldTabindex === '') {
                                link.removeAttribute('tabindex');
                            } else {
                                link.setAttribute('tabindex', oldTabindex);
                            }
                            link.removeAttribute('data-old-tabindex');
                        } else if (link.getAttribute('tabindex') === '-1') {
                            link.removeAttribute('tabindex');
                        }

                        link.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
                    } else {
                        if (!link.hasAttribute('data-old-tabindex')) {
                            var prev = link.getAttribute('tabindex');
                            link.setAttribute('data-old-tabindex', prev === null ? '' : prev);

                        link.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
                        link.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

            // Only redirect focus if the active element is inside the carousel container
            var active = document.activeElement;
            var carouselContainer = document.querySelector('.nbs-flexisel-container');
            if (
                active &&
                active.tagName &&
                active.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'a' &&
                active.getAttribute('tabindex') === '-1' &&
                carouselContainer &&
                carouselContainer.contains(active)
            ) {
                var visibleLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nbs-flexisel-item a:not([tabindex="-1"])');
                if (visibleLinks.length > 0) {
                    visibleLinks[0].focus();
                } else {
                    var nextBtn = getNextBtn();
                    if (nextBtn) {

                    }
                }
            }

        function setPausedState(paused) {
            var btn = document.getElementById('btnCarouselToggle');
            var iconSpan = document.getElementById('ppIcon');
            var $carousel = $('#flexiselDemo3');

            pibCarouselPaused = paused;

            if (paused) {

                }
                if (btn) {
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause Slideshow');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
                }
            }
        }

        function moveCarousel(direction) {
            var prevBtn = getPrevBtn();
            var nextBtn = getNextBtn();

            if (pibCarouselPaused) {
                setPausedState(false);

                setTimeout(function () {
                    if (direction === 'left' && prevBtn) {
                        prevBtn.click();
                    }
                    if (direction === 'right' && nextBtn) {
                        nextBtn.click();
                    }

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        setPausedState(true);
                        scheduleFocusRefresh();
                    }, 400);
                }, 50);
            } else {
                if (direction === 'left' && prevBtn) {
                    prevBtn.click();
                }
                if (direction === 'right' && nextBtn) {
                    nextBtn.click();
                }

                scheduleFocusRefresh();
            }
        }

        function getFirstVisibleSlideLabel() {
            var viewport = getCarouselViewport();
            if (!viewport) return '';
            var viewportRect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
            var items = getCarouselItems();
            for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                var link = items[i].querySelector('a');
                if (!link || !link.offsetParent) continue;
                var r = link.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (r.left >= viewportRect.left && r.right <= viewportRect.right && r.width > 0) {
                    var img = link.querySelector('img');
                    if (img) { var alt = (img.getAttribute('alt') || img.getAttribute('title') || '').trim(); if (alt) return alt; }
                    var txt = (link.textContent || '').trim(); if (txt) return txt;
                }
            }
            return '';
        }

        function announceFooterSlideChange() {
            var el = document.getElementById('footerCarouselStatus');
            if (!el) return;
            var label = getFirstVisibleSlideLabel();
            var msg = 'Slide changed';
            if (label) msg += ': ' + label;
            el.textContent = '';
            setTimeout(function () { el.textContent = msg; }, 100);
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            var btn = document.getElementById('btnCarouselToggle');

            setTimeout(function () {
                refreshNavA11y();
                manageCarouselFocus();
            }, 700);

            if (btn) {
                btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setPausedState(!pibCarouselPaused);
                    scheduleFocusRefresh();
                });
            }

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                var target = e.target;
                if (!target) return;

                var isPrev = target.classList.contains('nbs-flexisel-nav-left');
                var isNext = target.classList.contains('nbs-flexisel-nav-right');
                var key = e.key || e.keyCode;

                if (isPrev || isNext) {
                    if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || key === 'Spacebar' || key === 13 || key === 32) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        moveCarousel(isPrev ? 'left' : 'right');
                        setTimeout(announceFooterSlideChange, 600);

            });

            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var target = e.target;
                if (!target) return;

                if (target.classList.contains('nbs-flexisel-nav-left') || target.classList.contains('nbs-flexisel-nav-right')) {

                    }
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        scheduleFocusRefresh();
                    }, 100);
                    setTimeout(announceFooterSlideChange, 600);

            window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleFocusRefresh);

            var scroller = document.querySelector('.logos_scroller');
